subject: Supplemental subprocessor notice — DataSprig onboarding and evidence request
messages:
From: Elena Morrison <elena.morrison@ecf-global.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 04 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: DataSprig added as analytics subprocessor (EdgeCircuit)

Hi Karthik,

Quick heads-up from the EdgeCircuit procurement team — we are onboarding a new analytics subprocessor, DataSprig (https://datasprig.co), to support the EdgeCircuit telemetry pipeline. Per our DPA Appendix B and our vendor governance process, we need Redwood to confirm whether this change impacts any subprocessor routing for the integration and to provide the following evidence items to satisfy our security review:

- SOC 2 Type II summary or attestation (most recent)
- High-level dataflow diagram showing where telemetry and customer PII (if any) traverse DataSprig systems
- Encryption key custody / KMS jurisdiction notes
- Any planned cross-border processing (countries)

I attached the DPA addendum draft and a short datasheet from DataSprig they shared. Can you confirm by EOD Friday whether Redwood requires a mitigation (e.g., onshore routing, contract addendum) or whether this is acceptable under our current controls?

Thanks — Elena

--
Elena Morrison
Vendor Governance | EdgeCircuit
elena.morrison@ecf-global.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: DPA-addendum-draft-EdgeCircuit.docx (docx), DataSprig-datasheet.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morrison <elena.morrison@ecf-global.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 04 Jun 2025 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: DataSprig added as analytics subprocessor (EdgeCircuit)

Elena — thanks for the heads-up and the attachments. Looping in Laura (legal) and Ben (security) to triage the evidence request. Initial notes from my side:

- Redwood currently routes EdgeCircuit telemetry to our observability pipeline; we do not share raw customer content with third-party analytics providers by default. Any callouts?
- If DataSprig will receive keyed telemetry containing tenant identifiers, we need the SOC2 + dataflow diagram before we allow routing to them.

Action items proposed:
1) Ben: quick controls review (SOC2 scope, encryption, KMS)
2) Laura: DPA addendum redline and minimal clause suggestions for routing/residency
3) Elena: ask DataSprig to provide the SOC2 summary and a PNG of the dataflow (prefer a redacted diagram).

We can aim to close this by Monday (09 Jun) if all items are provided. If we need an onshore fallback, we will propose a conditional routing clause in the addendum.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: DataSprig Security <security@datasprig.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Morrison <elena.morrison@ecf-global.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 05 Jun 2025 08:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: DataSprig added as analytics subprocessor (EdgeCircuit) — Evidence package

Hi all,

Thanks for the note. Attached are the items you requested: the SOC 2 Type II executive summary (redacted), a PNG dataflow that highlights ingestion paths and processing locations, and a short KMS note regarding key custody (we use AWS KMS in us-east-1 with customer key rotation options).

High-level clarifications:
- DataSprig will process telemetry events for EdgeCircuit but will not store raw PII fields unless explicitly enabled by the customer. Default ingest is pseudonymized event IDs and telemetry metrics.
- Processing locations: primary in us-east-1, 2ndary in eu-west-1 for redundancy. Cross-border replicates only occur for redundancy and are encrypted in transit and at rest.
- We are happy to accept a contractual requirement to keep EdgeCircuit tenant data onshore if requested.

Attachments (stubs): DataSprig-SOC2-summary-2024.pdf (pdf), datasprig-dataflow-2025.png (png), datasprig-kms-note.txt (txt)

Please confirm receipt and let us know whether anything else is required.

Regards,
Maya Patel
Security Ops | DataSprig
security@datasprig.co

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morrison <elena.morrison@ecf-global.com>, DataSprig Security <security@datasprig.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 06 Jun 2025 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: DataSprig added as analytics subprocessor (EdgeCircuit) — next steps

Elena / Maya — thanks for the prompt responses and for sending the SOC2 summary and dataflow. I reviewed the addendum draft and Ben completed a brief controls read. Outcome and next steps: 

- Controls look reasonable on the face (SOC2 summary acceptable scope). Ben flagged that cross-border redundancy to eu-west-1 is permitted only if EdgeCircuit explicitly authorizes EU replication in the DPA; please confirm if EdgeCircuit requires EU residency for any tenants.
- Contract: we propose adding a short clause to Appendix B requiring explicit residency selection per tenant and an interim onshore routing control for any tenant marked as EU-resident until DataSprig enables geo-fencing filters. I redlined the attached DPA addendum with that language (see DPA-addendum-draft-EdgeCircuit.docx).
- Evidence: please provide the full SOC2 report under an NDA if EdgeCircuit requests deeper review; for now the executive summary suffices for preliminary clearance.

If EdgeCircuit agrees to the residency clause and DataSprig confirms willingness to accept the addendum, Redwood will permit conditional routing to DataSprig for non-resident tenants. Please confirm by close of business Monday 09 Jun so we can finalize procurement changes.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
--
Attachments: DPA-addendum-draft-EdgeCircuit.docx (redline included)
